title: Noteblock Dialog
description: A datapack that allows the user to change a note or instrument of a block using the in-game dialog UI.
body:
# Noteblock Dialog
### Precision note-tuning made easy.

Tired of right-clicking a Noteblock twenty times just because you missed the note you wanted? Noteblock Dialog brings a clean, intuitive GUI to Minecraft, allowing you to manage your musical creations without the headache.

## Features
- Intuitive GUI: Open a menu directly over any Noteblock to select your instrument and note precisely.
  
- Smart Interactions: Simply look at a Noteblock (within 6 blocks) and press your Swap Off-hand key (Default: F) to open the interface.
 
- Auto-Platforming: Enable a setting to automatically place the required block beneath the Noteblock to get the instrument you want.
  
- Debug Raycasting: Includes a visibility debug mode to help you see exactly where the tool is targeting.
  
- Clean Chat: Built-in shortcut to toggle sendCommandFeedback, keeping your chat clean from trigger spam.

## How to Use
- Stand within 6 blocks of a Noteblock.
  
- Look directly at the block.
  
- Press F (or your custom Swap Off-hand key).
  
- Adjust your settings or notes in the popup menu!

## Planned Features
I’m working on making this the ultimate composer's tool. Future updates will include:

- Manual Toggle: Ability to disable the F hotkey for those who prefer manual command opening.
  
- Survival Mode Logic: A challenge mode where changing an instrument requires having the corresponding block in your inventory.
  
- Advanced Debugging: More granular settings for technical builders.

Note: To prevent chat clutter, use the in-game shortcut provided by the pack to disable command feedback!
